title: Review OverLit ad reliability
prompt:
Review OverLit’s advertising system independently and read-only. The owner explicitly asked for a GPT-6 Astra review because ads are important and currently work well. Determine whether the actual ad lifecycle and privacy gates work correctly and whether complexity creates a concrete maintenance or reliability hazard. Do not force changes, redesign the system, disable monetization wholesale, edit source, run competing native builds/emulators, or touch provider/store settings.

Work in /Users/alekj/Documents/GitHub/OverLit-app on the existing checkout. You are not alone: “Assess chained-cell mechanic” (01a0ff00-4a04-7191-bd57-fcf1159ab963) owns gameplay and combined native gates; “Fix OverLit privacy and deletion safety” (01a103fa-9e84-7771-8d4a-f16a9157f474) owns privacy/ad-audience/deletion changes and is completing region-transition fixes. Coordinate read-only observations with both chats; the owner authorizes these messages. Do not revert anyone’s changes. Read applicable AGENTS and legal skills, Docs/reviews/2026-10-04-privacy-remediation.md and current ad code. Read-only snapshot/diff inspection is sufficient while mutable work is underway.

Owner facts: Polish sole trader, personal publisher, intended released audience 13+, available in South Korea and India. Voice is separate. Country is a heuristic, not verified residence. Legal age thresholds are purpose-specific; do not treat every teen as legally a child or every UMP location as GDPR scope. Anonymous Firebase IDs are personal data. Firebase Analytics is build-deactivated, Tenjin held inactive, Crashlytics unlinked in prepared remediation; AdMob remains. Latest prepared public privacy version will be 3.7.0 (2026-10-04), Terms3.2.0. None of this proves deployment. Native TFUA should map to CHILD for that exact flag, not TEEN; do not broaden this mapping to all teens without reviewing inputs.

Trace Android and iOS SDK initialization, UMP fresh audience evidence, ATT where used, age/region/consent changes and app relaunch, full-screen/rewarded/banner eligibility, personalized/nonpersonalized restrictions, failed network/UMP, stale callback invalidation, preloaded ads, rewarded grant integrity, privacy-options reopening, paid remove-ads, and background/foreground lifetime. Focus on demonstrable defects or unnecessary duplicated state that causes them. Check actual SDK documentation when a claim depends on behavior/version. Review pending region-transition work as pending, and distinguish a finding already fixed from remaining defects.

Deliver a short evidence-backed report with file/line references, tested versus inferred claims, a maintainability assessment, and only concrete prioritized fixes (or say no further fix justified). Do not assert that ads legally protect the owner or make the app compliant. Store/provider console and actual signed-release behavior remain separately unverifiable from source. Prefer a small set of meaningful checks over broad test construction. If you need execution, coordinate the established gate owner first. You may write only your report under Docs/reviews/2026-10-04-ad-system-independent-review.md with a normal approved file operation; preserve others’ work. Message the privacy chat with findings that need attention and report completion to the root chat.
